QUOTE: "Stack-based allocator. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) carves allocations out of a caller-supplied buffer and never calls libc. It installs its own functions by calling `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs its own functions via the runtime setter. It does not say "only in-tree user" outright, but it also lists test and benchmark code as users of the same hook, which weakens that part. The core mechanism and location are stated.
